issue_request: FHIR-40709 is an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-core ValueSet issue asking the vocab work group to consider a select-by-map ValueSet use case, where selection can include source codes mapped to selected target codes. The final resolution was to move the temporary fhir-tools extension as defined, plus its associated value set, to the Extensions Pack at maturity level 1.
initial_application: No FHIR core source application was found. The Jira comments link HL7/fhir-extensions#120, and Extension Pack commit 9e454aa added StructureDefinition-valueset-select-by-map.xml and ValueSet-select-by-map-filter.xml under input/definitions/ValueSet. Later Extension Pack commits corrected the canonical id/URL, committee URL, r4-equivalence system URL, and responsible work-group code.
additional_context: VOC May 2024 WGM minutes corroborate the Jira resolution and call the fhir-tools page a temporary location for an extension that would move to the Extensions Pack. FHIR-46218 is a later Published FHIR-extensions tracker for the same migration and tooling-IG deprecation. Current published Extension Pack pages expose the Select By Map extension and select-by-map-filter value set.
